subject: Finlytics POC: delivery mode decision + access checklist
messages:
From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial POC scheduling - Finlytics / Redwood

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. The team at Finlytics is ready to move to a hands-on POC and we wanted to lock in dates and format. High level asks: prompt review and routing validation, a short load test targeting our peak flows (approx 20 concurrent streams), and a working session for our infra and platform teams to validate network egress and KV caching behavior.

Couple of scheduling constraints on our side: week of Apr 25 works best but pref Monday or Tuesday only; we have two folks who need visitor badges if onsite (Priya and myself). Could you propose options for onsite vs virtual and any access forms we need to complete? Also please point us to an agenda so we can prep prompts.

Best,
Sam
Sam Walker
Director, Platform Engineering
Finlytics

Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial POC scheduling - Finlytics / Redwood

Hi Sam — great to hear you're ready. Quick options so we can tee this up:

Option A (Onsite):
- Date: Tue, Apr 26, 09:00–16:00 PT (hands-on lab + load window 13:00–14:00)
- Redwood will bring a small test harness for routing/load; we need 2 guest passes and a conference room with dual HDMI + Zoom room.
- We’ll request recording permission for internal troubleshooting (see consent language below).

Option B (Virtual):
- Date: Mon, Apr 25, 10:00–15:00 PT (includes 60m load window)
- Zoom meeting + shared VM access; we’ll run the same load but will need a short network/proxy diagram from your infra team.

Agenda (draft):
- 10:00 Intro + objectives (15m)
- 10:15 Prompt walkthrough & dataset alignment (45m)
- 11:00 Routing & fallback configuration review (30m)
- 11:45 Lunch / buffer (30m)
- 12:15 Hands-on prompt tuning + KV caching demo (90m)
- 13:45 Load test (60m)
- 14:45 Wrap / next steps (30m)

For onsite visitor access we need the Visitor Pass Form completed (I’ve attached our standard template). If you prefer virtual, pls confirm your preference and we’ll send updated calendar invites and access links.

Consent for recording (if onsite): Redwood records sessions for post-mortem and debugging. We store recordings on an internal S3 bucket for 30 days and provide redacted clips if requested. If that works, we’ll include that consent line in the visitor form.

I’ve attached an initial agenda (POC-Agenda-v2.pdf) and the Visitor Pass Form.

Thanks — if you confirm preferred option I’ll coordinate facilities and Connor will validate the load plan.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Quick note on room and AV if we go onsite:
- Need conference room with dual displays + in-room mic. If you want us to host the Zoom room recording we can — otherwise Finlytics can start the Zoom and we’ll join.
- For guest badges: facilities requires names, company, and photo ID 48 hours before arrival.
- If we record, we’ll capture the main screen and console output; no raw customer data will be uploaded to public endpoints.

Sam — if you think Priya will need console access, let us know and Connor will provision limited session creds ahead of time.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial POC scheduling - Finlytics / Redwood

Hi all — a few technical notes for the load window and routing test:
- Target: 20 concurrent client streams, token distribution similar to prod (avg seq len ~240).
- Please confirm expected RTT from your test clients to the Redwood endpoint; I’ll tune batching/windowing to hit ~100–150ms p95 if possible.
- If onsite, we’ll run the load generator from our lab machine on your network (requires an open egress rule to 10.12.4.0/22 and outbound to our collector at 52.14.88.32:443).
- For virtual tests, we’ll need a NAT exit IP range or a VPN tunnel to avoid asymmetric routing issues — Priya, can your team provide a quick diagram?

I’ve attached a short checklist for pre-test validation and the guest pass form PDF.

Connor O'Brien
Performance Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: pretest-checklist.txt, Visitor-Pass-Form.pdf

Thanks everyone — quick responses below:
- We prefer onsite if we can get the 26th; Priya and I will need guest badges and we can provide photos by EOD Thu (14th).
- Facilities: please advise how we submit IDs and who to contact for day-of passes.
- Recording: fine with us for troubleshooting clips; please ensure any log snippets are redacted for PII.
- Network: Priya’s team will share a short network diagram by EOD tomorrow; we can also open the egress range you listed.

Confirming: select Option A (Onsite) for Tue, Apr 26. Please send a calendar invite with room and Zoom link so our remote folks can join.

Sam
